name: format_fixed_point_digits
description: Writes a zero character, then copies digits from a source string into the output, inserting a decimal point and trailing fill characters when the frame flag and counts require them. It stores the final output length to a result pointer and returns an incremented frame value.

name: emit_mantissa_digits_padded
description: Writes a decimal point when a frame flag is set, then copies digits from a source string and writes zero characters once the digit count is exhausted. If the field is flagged and shorter than its limit, it appends fill characters, stores the output length and returns an incremented frame value.

name: emit_digits_with_zero_fill
description: Writes a zero character, then copies digits from a source string, re-emitting a zero whenever the source digit count runs out, until the remaining count reaches zero. It then appends fill characters when the flag and limit conditions hold, stores the output length and returns an incremented frame value.

name: format_scientific_digit_lead
description: Writes one digit from the source string, or a zero character when none is left, followed by a decimal point and the remaining mantissa digits. It appends an exponent marker, a sign and exponent digits produced by repeated division, then stores the output length and returns an incremented frame value.

name: format_scientific_zero_lead
description: Writes a zero character and a decimal point, then copies the remaining mantissa digits from a source string, re-emitting zeros when the count is exhausted. It appends an exponent marker, a sign and exponent digits produced by repeated division, then stores the output length and returns an incremented frame value.

name: emit_mantissa_then_exponent
description: Writes a zero character and copies mantissa digits in a loop, writing zeros when the source is exhausted. Once the digit count is used up, it appends an exponent marker, a sign and exponent digits, applies optional fill characters, stores the output length and returns an incremented frame value.

name: append_exponent_sign_and_digits
description: Writes an exponent marker and a sign character, negating the exponent when it is negative. It converts the exponent into eleven digit characters by repeated division, copies them to the output and applies optional fill characters before storing the output length.

name: write_plus_and_exponent_digits
description: Writes a plus character, converts the value into eleven decimal digit characters by repeated division, and copies them to the output. It then applies optional fill characters, stores the output length and returns an incremented frame value.

name: pad_output_with_fill_character
description: Repeatedly writes a fill character from a frame slot into the output while a frame counter is positive, a flag is set and the field is shorter than its limit. It stores the output length and returns an incremented frame value.

name: copy_value_and_increment_counter
description: Stores a value from the local frame into the location held by a pointer argument, then returns a frame argument plus one. The routine performs one store and one addition before returning.

name: initialise_entity_record_state
description: Sets a block of byte fields in a record, addressed by a base pointer, to constants and copies table entries from a global lookup into it, then resets timer fields and clears a global array. Its entry is tied to the referenced text Attack-, and the listing is cut off partway, so only the opening part is described.

name: refresh_entity_record_fields
description: Copies a lookup value into the record's fields and sets its timer and state bytes. It resets selected global entries to a fixed value, loops over table slots and clears a block of eight global entries before continuing.

name: process_entity_record_update
description: Converts a lookup value into the record's shape and state fields, then loops over a table of entries and marks the record with a fixed value when finished. It decrements the timer field and clears a list of global slots as the loop progresses.

name: dispatch_command_byte_cases
description: Reads a command byte through a helper and branches to one of several cases, each of which updates record bytes, sets flags or advances an offset. The listing ends partway through the loop, so the later cases are not covered.

name: dispatch_command_byte_entry
description: Reads a command byte through a helper; for the open-parenthesis and comma values it sets a mode byte and its companion before running the common update. Other values are dispatched to cases that update record bytes, clear a global counter or load a value into the record, and the listing ends partway through the loop.

name: set_mode_then_update_record
description: Sets a mode byte and its companion in the record to a fixed value, then runs the same command dispatch and record update as its neighbour. It stores a changed value into a record field and loops over a global counter, and the listing is cut off partway through that loop.

name: set_second_mode_then_update
description: Sets a second mode byte and its companion in the record to a different fixed value, then runs the same command dispatch and record update as the neighbouring routines. It stores a changed value into a record field and runs a global counter loop, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: copy_index_then_update_record
description: Sets a fixed step value in the record and copies an index byte into a second record field, branching on whether that index is zero before the shared update runs. The referenced text is Cast by whom?, and the listing ends partway through the command dispatch.

name: run_record_state_update
description: Runs the shared command dispatch, which reads a command byte through a helper and updates record fields, then stores a changed value into a record field. It runs a counter loop that clears per-record bytes, and the listing is cut off partway through that loop.

name: apply_record_opcode_switch
description: Derives an opcode value from a lookup byte using range tests, then runs a switch with many cases that adjust record timers, counters, flags and fields. Several cases copy values between record bytes or clear global entries, and others branch back into the shared update.

name: classify_record_opcode_and_switch
description: Derives an opcode from a lookup byte using range tests, then runs the same switch as its neighbouring routines, adjusting record timers, counters, flags and fields. The referenced text includes CLERIC SPELL-, SPELL TYPE W/C- and WIZARD SPELL-, and the listing is cut off partway through the switch cases.

name: return_helper_result_after_calls
description: Calls three helper routines in sequence and returns the value produced by the first of them. It is a thin wrapper that performs no direct reads or writes of record data.

name: mark_record_state_then_update
description: When a mode byte is 128, a state byte is 48 and a flag byte is still clear, it sets that flag and clears a field before running the shared command dispatch. The listing ends partway through that dispatch.

name: store_flagged_value_then_update
description: Reads a value through a helper, sets a flag bit in it and stores the result in a record field. When the mode byte is 128 it copies a table entry into the record and continues into the shared command dispatch; the referenced text is DIRECT-, and the listing cuts off partway through that dispatch.

name: set_timer_then_run_update
description: Sets a record timer field to a fixed value and runs the shared command dispatch, which reads a command byte and updates record fields. The routine ends with a counter loop that clears per-record bytes, and the listing is cut off inside that loop.

name: advance_counter_then_update
description: When the mode byte is 1 and a counter field is below 7, it increments that counter and enters the shared update through the global loop. Otherwise it runs the shared command dispatch directly, and the listing cuts off partway through its counter loop.

name: increment_counter_then_copy
description: Increments a record counter field, then copies bytes produced by a helper into two record fields until a zero byte is read. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: decrement_counter_then_copy
description: When the mode byte is 1 and a counter field is non-zero, it decrements that counter and copies bytes from a helper into two record fields until a zero byte is read. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: set_limit_then_copy_entry
description: Sets a record limit field to 75 and, when the mode byte is 128, copies a table entry into the record. It then runs the shared command dispatch, and the listing is cut off partway through that dispatch.

name: copy_pairs_until_marker
description: When the mode byte is zero and the companion byte is not 22, it copies byte pairs from a helper into the record until a marker value of four is read. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: double_value_then_copy_entry
description: Reads a helper value, doubles it into a record limit field and, when the mode byte is 128, copies a table entry into the record. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: set_long_timer_then_update
description: Sets a record timer field to 250 and runs the shared command dispatch, which updates record fields and then clears per-record bytes in a counter loop. The listing is cut off inside that loop.

name: dispatch_opcode_range_byte
description: Reads bytes through a helper until one falls in a fixed range, derives an opcode from it and runs a switch with many cases. The cases adjust record timers, counters and fields, copy table entries into the record or clear global entries, and some branch into the shared update; the listing ends partway through the switch.

name: set_limit_then_flag_loop
description: Sets a record limit field to 75 and, when the mode byte is 128, runs an eight-step loop over a flag set that updates record entries. It then runs the shared command dispatch, and the listing is cut off partway through that dispatch.

name: loop_flags_then_update
description: Runs an eight-step loop that tests a flag byte from a helper against a global entry and copies matching entries into the record. It then runs the shared command dispatch, and the listing is cut off partway through that dispatch.

name: set_max_limit_copy_entry
description: Sets a record limit field to 255 and, when the mode byte is 128, copies a table entry into the record. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: set_delay_then_update_record
description: Sets a record delay field to 20 and runs the shared command dispatch, which updates record fields and clears per-record bytes through a counter loop. The listing is cut off inside that loop.

name: double_value_then_flag_loop
description: Reads a helper value and doubles it into a record limit field. When the mode byte is 128 it runs an eight-step loop that copies flagged entries into the record, then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: set_active_globals_to_five
description: When the mode byte is 128, sets each non-zero entry of an eight-slot global array to five, then runs the shared command dispatch. The listing is cut off partway through that dispatch.

name: set_nonzero_globals_to_five
description: Sets each non-zero entry of an eight-slot global array to five, then runs the shared command dispatch. The listing is cut off partway through that dispatch.

name: copy_global_into_record_header
description: Copies a global entry into two record bytes, writes the fixed value 120 to the output location and then writes a record field there. It is a short routine of a few moves that ends with a return.

name: set_max_limit_flag_loop
description: Sets a record limit field to 255 and, when the mode byte is 128, runs an eight-step loop over a flag set that updates record entries. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: set_flag_at_state_fifty
description: When the mode byte is 128, the state byte is 50 and a flag byte is clear, it sets that flag, then sets a record limit field to 255 and runs an eight-step flag loop. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: set_limit_from_helper_value
description: Reads a value through a helper and stores it in a record limit field, then branches on whether the value is zero before running the shared command dispatch. The listing cuts off partway through that dispatch.

name: branch_on_zero_flag_update
description: Tests the zero condition left by a helper and branches into the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through. The referenced text is HEAL WHOM?-.

name: copy_bytes_until_zero_update
description: When the mode byte is 1, copies bytes from a helper into two record fields until a zero byte is read. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: set_cure_marker_then_update
description: Tests a zero flag left by a helper and, when a record marker byte is 208, changes it to 199 before running the shared command dispatch. The referenced text is CURE WHOM?-, and the listing cuts off partway through that dispatch.

name: decode_marker_byte_then_update
description: Maps a command byte in a fixed range to an output marker value, or in mode 1 checks for a specific character instead. It then applies bit tests on a counter field to pick one of several record updates, and runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: reset_record_from_saved_slots
description: When the mode byte is 1, copies two saved record bytes back into the record, sets the byte at offset twelve to 255 and clears the mode byte. It then tests a few helper results, may write 122 to an output byte, and continues into the shared update, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: store_limit_then_update_record
description: Reads a value through a helper, stores it in a record limit field and branches on whether the value is zero before running the shared command dispatch. The listing cuts off partway through that dispatch.

name: save_global_then_update
description: When the mode byte is not 1, saves a global value into a temporary record byte, sets the global to 10 and then reassigns the saved value. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: set_global_sequence_then_update
description: Sets a global value to 10 and then to 4, and runs the shared command dispatch. The listing is cut off partway through that dispatch.

name: adjust_marker_by_helper_bits
description: When the mode byte is not 128 and a record marker byte is 196, it sets the marker to 199 or to 193 depending on the low bits of a helper value. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: set_marker_199_then_update
description: Sets a record marker byte to 199 and runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through its counter loop.

name: recall_marker_adjust_counter
description: When the mode byte is not 128 and a marker byte is 193, it swaps a record byte temporarily, subtracts five from a decimal counter with BCD adjustment and sets the marker to 199. The referenced text is RECALL WHOM?-, and the listing cuts off partway through the shared dispatch.

name: run_shared_command_update
description: Makes two helper calls and then runs the shared command dispatch and the counter loop that clears per-record bytes. The listing is cut off partway through that loop.

name: run_counter_loop_update
description: Makes one helper call and then runs the shared command dispatch and the counter loop that clears per-record bytes. The listing is cut off partway through that loop.

name: call_four_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls four helper routines in succession and returns, performing no other operations on data.

name: forward_single_call_stub
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other operations. The listing shows only that call, so the stub adds no behaviour of its own.

name: call_three_helpers_return_pair
description: Calls three helper routines in sequence and returns a 64-bit value built from the two result registers. It performs no direct data operations of its own.

name: run_descend_command_update
description: Makes two helper calls and then runs the shared command dispatch and the counter loop that clears per-record bytes. The referenced text is Descend, and the listing is cut off partway through that loop.

name: run_enter_command_update
description: Makes one helper call, changes a marker byte from 208 to 199 when it has that value, and runs the shared command dispatch. The referenced text is Enter, and the listing cuts off partway through the dispatch.

name: match_header_pair_set_state
description: Searches a table of twenty global byte pairs for one matching the record's two header bytes and keeps its index. It then sets several record state fields according to a record type byte, writes an offset of that index to a global and runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: select_record_state_from_index
description: Checks a record pair against two indexed reference arrays and, on a match, stores the index in a record field. It then sets state fields from a record type byte and a global value, and runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: set_state_type_twelve_fourteen
description: For a record type byte of 12 or 14, sets several state fields, adds 65 to a stored index and writes the result to a global. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: set_state_for_type_fourteen
description: For a record type byte of 14, sets a timer field to 30 and several state fields, adds 65 to a stored index and writes the result to a global. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: enter_shared_update_loop
description: Makes two helper calls and enters the shared command dispatch, which ends in the counter loop that clears per-record bytes. The listing cuts off partway through that loop.

name: write_offset_index_then_update
description: Adds 65 to a stored index and writes it to a global value. Unless the mode byte is 1, it then sets that global to 2, 7 or 3 depending on the mode byte and a saved header byte, and runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: select_status_seven_or_three
description: Sets a global status to 7 when a saved header byte equals it and to 3 otherwise, then runs the shared command dispatch. The listing is cut off partway through that dispatch.

name: set_global_status_three
description: Sets a global status to 3 and runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through its counter loop.

name: clear_marker_then_dispatch_byte
description: Clears a record marker and timer, then reads a byte through a helper and branches on specific values. Those branches step a two-bit counter up or down and select record offsets, while a switch over high-range values adjusts counters and markers; the listing ends partway through the switch.

name: check_global_then_clear_state
description: Reads a value through a helper and, when it equals minus 8, compares a global with minus 98. It then calls another routine, sets the global to 11 and runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: branch_on_zero_set_global
description: When an earlier zero flag is set, compares a global with minus 98, calls another routine and sets the global to 11 before running the shared command dispatch. The listing cuts off partway through that dispatch.

name: check_global_set_eleven_update
description: Compares a global with minus 98 and calls another routine in one case, then sets the global to 11 before running the shared command dispatch. The listing cuts off partway through that dispatch.

name: call_routine_set_global_eleven
description: Calls another routine, sets a global to 11 and runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through its counter loop.

name: scan_grid_cells_four_steps
description: When a record byte equals 22, advances a position by a stored offset four times, wrapping each coordinate at 64. At each step it tests a global cell, writes 244 to the output and then copies or clears the cell; the referenced text is Fire!, and the listing cuts off partway through the shared dispatch.

name: scan_grid_cells_after_branch
description: Advances a position by a stored offset four times, wrapping each coordinate at 64. At each step it tests a global cell, writes 244 to the output and then copies or clears the cell, and the listing cuts off partway through the shared dispatch.

name: scan_grid_cells_then_update
description: Advances a position by a stored offset four times, wrapping each coordinate at 64. At each step it tests a global cell, writes 244 to the output and then copies or clears the cell before running the shared dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: run_shared_update_one_call
description: Makes one helper call and then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through its counter loop.

name: copy_indexed_entry_then_update
description: Stores a byte from the input register as an index, writes the indexed table entry to the output and clears that entry under a threshold test. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: dispatch_small_state_cases
description: Clears a table entry indexed by a record byte and then dispatches on a small state value to one of several cases, each of which calls helper routines. The listing contains unresolved indirect transfers of control, so only the opening part of the routine is described.

name: store_stack_byte_then_update
description: Writes a byte from the stack frame to the output and runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through its counter loop.

name: set_offset_thirteen_then_update
description: Sets the byte at offset thirteen of the record to 255, then tests a helper result and branches before running the shared command dispatch. The listing cuts off partway through that dispatch.

name: test_flag_then_run_update
description: Branches on a zero flag left by a helper, then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through its counter loop.

name: decode_marker_or_character
description: In mode 1 it checks for a specific character and sets a marker to zero; otherwise it maps a command byte in a fixed range to a marker value. It applies bit tests on a counter field to pick one of several record updates, then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: enter_shared_update_direct
description: Makes one helper call and enters the shared command dispatch at its start, which ends in the counter loop that clears per-record bytes. The listing is cut off partway through that loop.

name: reset_marker_then_apply_slot
description: When a command byte is the at-sign character, sets a marker to zero. It then tests the byte at offset thirteen and applies a case analysis on a two-bit value that may set a marker to 208 or walk a table, before running the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: apply_slot_thirteen_case
description: Tests the byte at offset thirteen and, when it is non-zero, applies a case analysis on a two-bit value that may set a marker to 208 or walk a table. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: offset_from_helper_then_update
description: When an earlier flag is clear, makes a few helper calls, computes a table offset from a helper value and runs the shared command dispatch. The listing cuts off partway through that dispatch.

name: set_marker_flag_then_offset
description: When an earlier flag is clear, sets a marker to 208, then computes a table offset from a helper value and runs the shared command dispatch. The listing cuts off partway through that dispatch.

name: skip_on_flag_then_update
description: Makes two helper calls and, when a zero flag is set, skips one helper call before the shared command dispatch. The listing is cut off partway through that dispatch's counter loop.

name: count_down_and_call_helpers
description: Copies a count byte into an index field and counts it down, calling helper routines on each step. When the index reaches zero it makes six further helper calls, then one more call before returning.

name: walk_index_then_update
description: Walks an index field down from a count value and sets a marker to 208 when the walk reaches zero. It then runs an offset calculation from a helper value and the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: return_value_unless_zero_flag
description: Calls a helper and returns its value unless a zero flag is set. When the flag is set it makes two helper calls and returns zero.

name: call_two_helpers_return_zero
description: Calls two helper routines and returns zero.

name: offset_bits_then_update_counter
description: Derives a table offset from a helper value using bit masks, then runs the shared command dispatch. When the value is zero it decrements a binary-coded decimal counter in the record; the referenced text is GOLD+ and the listing cuts off partway through the dispatch.

name: offset_masks_then_update
description: Derives a table offset from a helper value using masks of seven and three, and writes a fixed value to an output byte when the offset is non-zero. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through; the referenced text is AND A.

name: offset_mask_three_then_update
description: When the negative flag is clear, derives a table offset from a helper value masked to two bits and makes a short adjustment before the shared command dispatch. The referenced text is AND, and the listing cuts off partway through that dispatch.

name: run_shared_update_from_label
description: Runs the shared command dispatch from its label, whose counter loop clears per-record bytes. The listing is cut off inside that loop.

name: branch_on_characters_adjust_counts
description: Tests a zero flag and a marker byte, swaps two slot bytes and then branches on specific character values. Each branch either copies a slot index into a binary-coded decimal counter adjusted by a record field, or decrements a counter at an indexed position; the referenced text is TO PLR-, F,G,E,W,A: and the listing cuts off partway through the shared dispatch.

name: reset_counter_then_update
description: Clears a record flag byte, makes two helper calls and runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through its counter loop.

name: restore_slot_when_marker_zero
description: When a marker byte is zero, restores an index byte from a saved copy. Either way it runs the shared command dispatch, and the referenced text is AMOUNT-; the listing cuts off partway through that dispatch.

name: restore_index_then_update
description: Restores an index byte from a saved copy, makes one helper call and runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through its counter loop.

name: restore_index_when_amount_zero
description: When a marker byte is zero, restores an index byte from a saved copy and goes on to the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through its counter loop. The referenced text is AMOUNT-.

name: restore_index_then_enter_update
description: Restores an index byte from a saved copy and makes two helper calls before entering the shared command dispatch. The listing cuts off partway through that dispatch's counter loop.

name: map_character_to_slot_adjust
description: Maps one of four character values to a slot index and subtracts a marker amount from that slot as a binary-coded decimal value. The result is stored only when the slot holds at least that amount; the referenced text is G,K,P,T:, and the listing cuts off partway through the shared dispatch.

name: map_three_characters_to_slot
description: Maps one of three character values to a slot index and subtracts a marker amount from that slot as a binary-coded decimal value. The result is stored only when the slot holds at least that amount, and the listing cuts off partway through the shared dispatch.

name: map_two_characters_to_slot
description: Maps one of two character values to a slot index and subtracts a marker amount from that slot as a binary-coded decimal value. The result is stored only when the slot holds at least that amount, and the listing cuts off partway through the shared dispatch.

name: map_one_character_to_slot
description: Checks one character value, maps it to a slot index and subtracts a marker amount from that slot as a binary-coded decimal value. The result is stored only when the slot holds at least that amount, and the listing cuts off partway through the shared dispatch.

name: enter_shared_update_late
description: Makes one helper call and enters the shared command dispatch at a later label, which ends in the counter loop that clears per-record bytes. The listing is cut off partway through that loop.

name: adjust_slot_from_register_index
description: Uses a register-supplied index to subtract a marker amount from a slot as a binary-coded decimal value, storing the result when the slot holds at least that amount. The referenced text is HOW MANY-, and the listing cuts off partway through the shared dispatch.

name: store_input_into_indexed_slot
description: Stores an input byte into a slot addressed by a register index, makes two helper calls and then enters the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: decrement_weapon_slot_counter
description: For a value between 194 and 208, maps it to a slot index and decrements the binary-coded decimal counter at that slot when it is non-zero. The referenced text is WHICH WEAPON:, and the listing cuts off partway through the shared dispatch.

name: decrement_slot_counter_then_update
description: Decrements the binary-coded decimal counter at a computed slot when it is non-zero, then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: enter_shared_update_after_pair
description: Makes two helper calls and enters the shared command dispatch, which ends in the counter loop that clears per-record bytes. The listing is cut off partway through that loop.

name: decrement_armour_slot_counter
description: For a value between 194 and 200, maps it to a slot index and decrements the counter at that slot when it is non-zero. The referenced text is WHICH ARMOUR:, and the listing cuts off partway through the shared dispatch.

name: store_decremented_input_in_slot
description: Stores an input byte minus one into a slot addressed by a register index, then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through its counter loop.

name: run_shared_update_after_calls
description: Makes two helper calls and runs the shared command dispatch, which ends in a counter loop that clears per-record bytes. The listing is cut off partway through that loop.

name: subtract_bcd_pair_with_borrow
description: Subtracts an input value from a two-byte binary-coded decimal value stored in a slot, propagating the borrow between the two bytes. It stores the result and returns zero when the slot holds at least that amount, and returns 255 otherwise.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_mode_one
description: When the mode byte is 1, decrements the binary-coded decimal counter at offset fifteen of the slot block if it is non-zero and sets a record timer to 255. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: decrement_torch_counter_on_flag
description: When an earlier zero flag is clear, decrements the binary-coded decimal counter at offset fifteen of the slot block if it is non-zero and sets a record timer to 255. The referenced text is WHOSE TORCH-, and the listing cuts off partway through the shared dispatch.

name: decrement_counter_fifteen_then_update
description: Decrements the binary-coded decimal counter at offset fifteen of the slot block if it is non-zero, sets a record timer to 255 and runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: enter_shared_update_from_top
description: Makes a helper call and enters the shared command dispatch, which ends in the counter loop that clears per-record bytes. The listing is cut off partway through that loop.

name: set_bcd_counter_from_input
description: Stores a binary-coded decimal value of an input byte minus one in the counter at offset fifteen of the slot block and sets a record timer to 255. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: merge_gold_slots_into_total
description: When an earlier zero flag is clear, moves a bounded number of slot-byte pairs at offsets 35 and 36 into running binary-coded decimal totals, zeroing the sources. The referenced text is Join gold to-, and the listing cuts off partway through the shared dispatch.

name: merge_slot_pairs_for_count
description: When the input count does not exceed a stored limit, sums pairs of slot bytes at offsets 35 and 36 into running binary-coded decimal totals, zeroing the sources and writing the totals back. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: merge_slot_pairs_then_update
description: Sums pairs of slot bytes at offsets 35 and 36 into running binary-coded decimal totals across an input count, zeroing the sources and writing the totals back. It then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through.

name: enter_shared_update_end_entry
description: Makes two helper calls and enters the shared command dispatch, which ends in the counter loop that clears per-record bytes. The listing is cut off partway through that loop.

name: run_look_command_update
description: Makes six helper calls and then runs the shared command dispatch, which the listing cuts off partway through its counter loop. The referenced text is Look-.

name: shift_global_counter_left_three
description: Returns a global counter value shifted left by three bits, which multiplies it by eight, and performs no other operations.

name: call_routine_with_duplicate_argument
description: Passes its single argument to another routine twice and returns without any further operations.

name: allocate_blocks_from_free_list
description: Walks a free list held in globals and takes the first block at least as large as the requested count. It unlinks an exact fit or splits a larger block, reduces a global free total by the count and returns the block pointer; it returns null when the count is below one or no block fits.

name: call_routine_pointer_and_value
description: Passes its first argument and a duplicate of its second argument to another routine, then returns without further operations.

name: free_block_back_into_list
description: Returns a block of a given size to a free list kept in address order, merging it with the following block when they touch and adding the size to a global free total. It returns zero on success and minus one when the size is below one or the block would overlap an existing free block.

name: check_signal_and_dispatch
description: Reads the signal state for two particular bits from the system and returns zero when neither is set. When one is set, it sends a fixed code chosen by which bit is set, sends the code for the number ten, calls a routine for each index below a global count and returns the result of a final call.

name: format_decimal_value_padded
description: Converts a 64-bit value into decimal digit characters in a scratch buffer, writing zeros for leading positions, then copies the digits to an output buffer. It stores the digit count in a result field and returns a value packing that count.

name: format_decimal_register_value
description: Converts a value passed in registers into decimal digits in a scratch buffer, copies the digits and their leading zeros to an output buffer, and stores the digit count in a result field.

name: count_decimal_digits_loop
description: Divides a 64-bit value by ten through a helper in a loop, counting digits and writing a zero character for each position up to a limit. It then copies the digits to an output buffer and stores the digit count.

name: normalise_and_format_digits
description: Shifts a 64-bit value left until its top bit is set, adjusting an exponent field as it goes, then writes digit characters and copies them to an output buffer. It stores the digit count in a result field.

name: pad_decimal_buffer_with_zeros
description: Writes zero characters into successive buffer positions while the position index is below a limit, then copies the buffered digits to the output and stores the digit count.

name: write_digit_run_into_buffer
description: Writes a digit character, computed from a register byte plus the zero character, into successive buffer positions. It then copies the digits to the output and stores the digit count.

name: decrement_loop_until_zero
description: Decrements a 16-bit register value in a loop until it reaches zero, then returns. It touches no other data or registers.

name: multiply_pair_by_ten
description: Multiplies a 64-bit value held in two registers by ten and returns the 64-bit result, using shifts, additions and carry tests to combine the high and low words.

name: shift_pair_with_decimal_correction
description: Shifts a 64-bit value held in two registers left one bit at a time for 64 steps. Each bit is folded into a small decimal accumulator, which has ten subtracted with a carry whenever it exceeds nine, so the routine converts binary to decimal digits.

name: divide_signed_magnitude_values
description: Divides one register value by another using their magnitudes and a restoring shift-and-subtract loop of 31 steps. The quotient takes the sign of the XOR of the two inputs, and the routine returns zero when either input is zero.

name: store_param_to_global
description: Stores its single argument into a global variable and returns, performing no other operations.

name: pack_mantissa_shift_ten
description: Clears the sign bit of the high word and, unless the result is zero, shifts the 64-bit pair left by ten bits. It sets the top bit of the high word and returns the pair, or zero when the value is zero.

name: shift_pair_set_top_bit
description: Shifts a 64-bit pair left by ten bits, feeding each bit of the low word into the high word, and returns the high word with its top bit set.

name: normalise_double_and_check_range
description: Shifts a 64-bit mantissa pair until its leading bit sits in place, tracking the exponent as it goes. It rounds the result by one unit in the last place and reports underflow or overflow through a helper with code one or two.

name: pack_double_with_exponent
description: Shifts a value left until its leading bit is set while counting the exponent, then packs the exponent and mantissa bits into a 64-bit floating-point result. It reports underflow with code one, returning zero, and overflow with code two, setting the exponent field to its maximum value.

name: report_underflow_return_zero
description: Reports an error with code one through a helper routine and returns zero.

name: report_overflow_return_max
description: Reports an error with code two through a helper routine, then returns a 64-bit value whose top 16 bits hold the high word with its exponent field set to the maximum value and whose remaining bits are zero.

name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Splits the command line into up to 32 arguments, skipping whitespace and treating double-quoted text as a single argument, and stores a pointer to each in a global table. With no arguments it opens the console; otherwise it takes input and output handles through system library calls, then sets status flags and calls the file-open routine.
